title: Ethics in Government Reform Act of 1993
short_title: Ethics in Government Reform Act of 1993

committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S2010-2011)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Governmental Affairs.
Subcommittee on Oversight of Government Management. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 103-63.

latest_action.text: Subcommittee on Oversight of Government Management. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 103-63.

summaries.text: Ethics in Government Reform Act of 1993 - Codifies in the Federal criminal code the lobbying restrictions on senior executive branch appointees under Executive Order 12834, generally and with certain technical changes and extends those restrictions to the Vice President, Members of Congress, and highly paid staffers. Prohibits the President, Vice President, Members of Congress, Federal Reserve Board Governors, and certain other Federal officials from receiving anything of value from a foreign government after their service or employment ends.
